name: 天鹅绒防滑不鼓包衣架款
description: 成排主图开场，防滑不鼓包痛点加绒面微距与空参数规格的衣柜收纳套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, pale greige panels #F2EFEA and #E7E4E0 for info and scene screens, one cool near-white #F7F8F9 for spec screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral broad front-left key with soft fill, high-key even on packshots, soft daylight in scenes, gentle contact shadows only, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless studio board and pale closet interior surfaces, matte rail and shelf edges, no gloss tabletops
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, in-image copy fully stripped, only blank label bars and empty leader-line slots remain
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in slate #2C3A47 with one amber #E8701A accent, flat, no fills, no 3d
styleLock.presentationRules: stable dead-on front elevation for the single unit, consistent scale across the set, units always grounded by a contact shadow, never clipped
noDrift: no rendered words, numbers or units inside the frame
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent tidy wardrobe-organisation visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, pale greige panels #F2EFEA and #E7E4E0, deep slate text #2C3A47 and one warm amber accent #E8701A; neutral studio lighting with a broad front-left key, soft fill and gentle contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif; thin single-weight line icon style; clean high-end homeware product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable dead-on front product elevation and consistent scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no rendered words or numbers inside the frame.

shots.intent: 用成排数量感在搜索列表里一眼抢到点击，同时暗示整组收纳的划算感
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, the shoulder-to-shoulder row receding gently to the right, whole row visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, broad front-left key with a soft fill card, gentle shared contact shadow
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace around the row
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A row of identical units standing shoulder to shoulder and receding gently to the right, photographed straight-on at eye level so the whole row reads and nothing is clipped. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a broad front-left key and a soft fill card on the shadow side, one gentle shared contact shadow grounding the row. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace around the row. Wide 16:9 banner crop, 4K commercial homeware quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no garments hung on the units, no fused or duplicated hooks, no warped straight lines, no floating units without contact shadow, no watermark, no fake logo, no text, no gradient background.

shots.intent: 一秒给出三条核心利益的结构位，图标与标签全部留空待填
shots.camera: dead-on 90-degree front elevation of a single unit, centred in the lower two thirds
shots.lighting: neutral broad front key with soft fill, minimal shadow, faint contact shadow at the base
shots.background: pale greige panel #F2EFEA with one empty slate footer band #2C3A47
shots.props: three thin-line icon glyphs and three blank rounded label bars
shots.whitespace: generous clean margin above the icon row
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One unit shown dead-on in a flat 90-degree front elevation, centred in the lower two thirds with the full silhouette readable. Above it three thin single-weight line icon glyphs, each sitting over one empty rounded label bar carrying no characters. Neutral broad front key light with soft fill, minimal shadow and a faint contact shadow at the base. Background pale greige panel #F2EFEA with one slim deep slate #2C3A47 footer band across the bottom left completely empty. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, generous clean margin above the icon row. Square 1:1 crop. Negative: no rendered words or numbers, no weight or angle values, no platform badges, no rating stars, no invented claims, no more than three icons, no filled or 3d icons, no props overlapping the product, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用同机位双栏把衣物滑落与肩部鼓包的日常烦恼放大，把主体放到解决侧
shots.camera: matched 90-degree side profile on both panels, identical crop
shots.lighting: left panel flatter and cooler, right panel soft front-left key, same height and direction on both
shots.background: warm grey studio wall #E7E4E0 on both panels
shots.props: one soft knit top on each panel, one plain unbranded bare wire hanger as the problem-side foil
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace inside either panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels photographed from the same 90-degree side profile with identical framing and crop. Left panel: a soft knit top drooping and sliding off an unbranded plain bare wire hanger, two creased shoulder dents bulging at the shoulders, flatter cooler light. Right panel: {product} carrying the same knit hanging straight and unwrinkled, soft front-left key light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background warm grey studio wall #E7E4E0 on both panels with gentle contact shadow only. The product occupies 50-60% per panel, no extra whitespace inside either panel. Vertical 4:5 crop. Negative: no recognizable face or body, no real competitor branding or trademark, no crossed-out product, no fabricated test results or statistics, no text, no watermark, no torn or stained garments, no garment floating without support.

shots.intent: 用微距把绒面摩擦质感与吊带卡槽的真实做工摊开，替卖点做证据
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on one contoured shoulder edge and strap notch, shot from slightly below at a low angle
shots.lighting: skimming side light from the right revealing fine pile texture, one controlled highlight on the shoulder crest
shots.background: pure white #FFFFFF falling out of focus
shots.whitespace: minimal whitespace, the texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on one contoured shoulder edge where the flocked surface meets the integrated strap notch. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from slightly below at a low angle so the notch reads in profile, shallow depth of field with the near edge crisp and the far end falling soft. Skimming side light from the right revealing fine pile texture and the matte finish of the coating, one controlled highlight along the shoulder crest, no harsh speculars. Pure white background #FFFFFF out of focus. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace because the texture is the subject. Square 1:1 crop. Negative: no blurry subject, no lint or loose fibres, no plastic gloss, no rust or plating marks on the metal hook, no duplicated or split edges, no leader lines or callout dots, no text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 把主体放进真实衣柜，让买家照着自己的挂杆想象整理后的样子
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level medium shot down the rail, nearest two units sharp, row running out of frame to the right
shots.lighting: soft window daylight from the left, 5200K, gentle shadows between garments
shots.background: warm off-white closet interior wall #F2EFEA with a white rail and shelf edge
shots.props: neutral-tone knit tops hung shoulder to shoulder and one folded garment draped over the lower bar of the front unit
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the upper right third
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} hung on a white closet rail inside a bright tidy wardrobe, each unit carrying one neutral-tone knit top hung shoulder to shoulder, the front unit with a folded garment draped over its lower bar. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed straight-on at eye level as a medium shot down the rail, the nearest two units sharp and the row running out of frame to the right. Soft window daylight from the left, 5200K, gentle shadows between the garments, no harsh speculars. Warm off-white closet interior wall #F2EFEA with a clean white rail and shelf edge. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, generous negative space on the upper right third. Square 1:1 crop. Negative: no people or hands, no legible garment neck labels, no brand marks, no dusty or cluttered closet, no garments slipping off the rail, no bent rail line, no text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用顶视造型图把收纳后的秩序感与款式氛围立住，承接情绪价值
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead flat lay angle
shots.lighting: even soft top light, low contrast, short gentle shadows under each hook
shots.props: one buttoned knit cardigan on the central unit, empty units scattered in a loose radial ring around the edges
shots.whitespace: wide clean margin around the outer ring of units
shots.promptTemplate: Overhead styled flat lay: one central unit of {product} carrying a neatly buttoned knit cardigan, surrounded by a loose radial scatter of empty units turned at varying angles on a seamless board. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle with the central garment squared flat to the frame. Even soft top light, low contrast, short gentle shadows under each hook. Background pale lilac-grey seamless board #EDEBEE. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame overall, wide clean margin around the outer ring of units. Square 1:1 crop. Negative: no hands or faces, no legible garment labels, no crumpled or tossed clothing, no merged or repeated hook shapes, no brand marks, no cast shadow crossing the knit, no text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用尺寸引线与放大镜框的结构位消解大小疑虑，数值全部留空待填
shots.camera: dead-on 90-degree front elevation, single unit centred and fully visible
shots.lighting: flat even high-key lighting, minimal soft shadow directly beneath the unit
shots.props: two thin-line circular magnifier inset discs, hairline dimension lines with end ticks, empty rounded label bars
shots.whitespace: clean generous margin in the left and right thirds for layout
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce spec infographic screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One unit shown dead-on in a flat 90-degree front elevation, centred and fully visible, with two thin-line circular magnifier insets at the upper corners holding close crops of the hook and of the shoulder notch. Hairline slate dimension lines with plain end ticks and empty rounded label bars, carrying no characters at all. Flat even high-key lighting with a minimal soft shadow directly beneath the unit. Background cool near-white panel #F7F8F9. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, clean generous margin in the left and right thirds for layout. Square 1:1 crop. Negative: no invented dimensions, no numbers or unit characters anywhere, no legible headline, no arrows pointing at nothing, no distorted silhouette proportions, no platform badges, no fake logo, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用两组束带分组让买家自己挑组合，纸带印刷位全部留白
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level with a very slight 3/4 turn so the bundle depth reads
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light from the front-left with soft fill, clean contact shadows under each band
shots.props: two wide blank paper belly bands wrapping the two groups, one pale one amber-toned, printed area left empty
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant lineup of {product}: two bundled groups of identical units, each wrapped through the middle with one wide blank paper belly band, arranged one slightly behind and above the other. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed straight-on at eye level with a very slight 3/4 turn so the depth of each bundle reads and both groups stay fully visible. Bright even high-key studio light from the front-left with soft fill, clean contact shadows under each band. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The two groups together occupy 60-70% of the frame, balanced whitespace above each band. Vertical 4:5 crop. Negative: no printed text or numbers on the bands, no pack-count claims, no brand wordmarks, no loose stray hooks, no fused or merged units, no plastic wrap sheen, no shipping boxes, no watermark.

shots.intent: 顶视清单式网格收口整组，把主体压在最大位并留一条空白横幅做转化位
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead flat lay angle, items squared to the grid
shots.lighting: even soft overhead light, low contrast, small consistent contact shadows
shots.background: soft greige seamless board #E9E6E2 with one wide blank white footer band #FFFFFF
shots.props: one folded knit, one lidded felt storage box and one small wooden block spaced at equal intervals, the product leading at centre-left
shots.whitespace: generous margin inside the empty footer band
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close, wide overhead flat lay grid of everyday wardrobe organisation items: {product} leading the layout as the largest element at centre-left, with one folded knit, one lidded felt storage box and one small wooden block placed at equal intervals around it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle with every item squared to the grid. Even soft overhead light, low contrast, small consistent contact shadows under each item. Background soft greige seamless board #E9E6E2 with one wide blank white footer band #FFFFFF across the bottom, left completely empty. The product occupies 35-40% of the frame as the dominant element, generous margin inside the empty footer band. Square 1:1 crop. Negative: no discounts or price numbers, no countdown or urgency graphics, no platform badges or review stars, no brand wordmark, no overlapping or cluttered items, no unrelated electronics or groceries, no legible text, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：01 纯白底成排衣架横向全景；02 单品正立面加三枚线性图标与底部横幅；03 顶视平铺，中央一件针织开衫挂在衣架上、四周环绕空衣架；04 肩部斜角放大加四条引线标注；05 两组束带分组陈列，纸带一浅一深；06 单品正立面加尺寸引线与两处圆形放大镜框；07 衣柜挂杆平视场景，同色针织衫成排且一件搭在下横杆；08 顶视清单式网格加底部横幅收口。品类判定：主体为衣柜用防滑衣架，属无电无电机的小件收纳用品，逐字取 家居日用 / 收纳整理，与给定提示一致，不落 家具家纺（非家具）也不落 家用电器。08 为跨品类清单一角，仅借用其顶视网格与留白收口结构，全组主体仍是单一衣架，不构成混合套装；05 仅是个别分组陈列图，非色卡式变体画廊，正常转化。已剥离：原品牌字标与平台徽章、星级与件数角标、原图英文标题与图标说明句、包装纸带印刷内容、衣物领标字样；承重、长宽、角度等一切数值不入稿，尺寸与规格改为空白引线、空标签条、空横幅与留空参数位占位，产品一律以 {product} 占位，可复用部分仅为分镜、机位、光位、背景与网格排版结构。
